title: ARADICE: Benchmarks for Dialectal and Cultural Capabilities in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing LLM performance disparities across English, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and low-resource regional Arabic dialects (Levantine, Egyptian, Gulf) using translated cognitive, reading comprehension, and dialect identification benchmarks.

Testing LLMs on a newly curated multiple-choice cultural knowledge dataset (AraDiCE-Culture) to measure regional cultural awareness (traditions, holidays, geography) across the Gulf, Egypt, and Levant, and assessing Western-centric biases in model outputs.
